customer: Hello, I'm a grad student in Texas hoping to sell my minivan to Northwind Auto soon. I've searched everywhere and can't find a paper title for it, so I'm worried I won't be able to complete the sale. Could you tell me what I should bring?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and no need to worry. Texas uses electronic titles, so the title is a record held by the state rather than a paper document, and there's no paper title to bring. We transfer the title electronically at your appointment, and if there was ever a loan on the minivan, the lender releases the lien electronically as well. You can read more in our article "States with electronic titles."
